onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity.schema.json, set ph_c_gravity_preset to {{ph_c_gravity_preset}}]
Set gravity preset to {{ph_c_gravity_preset}}. Moon=gravity scale ~0.3, slow floaty arcs. Normal=scale 1.0. Heavy=scale 2.5, fast snappy arcs.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity.schema.json, set ph_c_fall_limit to {{ph_c_fall_limit}}]
Set the fall speed limit to {{ph_c_fall_limit}}. Slow=maxFallSpeed~10. Normal=20. Fast=50+.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity.schema.json, set ph_t_gravity_scale to {{ph_t_gravity_scale}}]
Scale gravity magnitude by {{ph_t_gravity_scale}}x in CharacterForceControllerBase. Current: fall_limit={{ph_c_fall_limit}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity.schema.json, set ph_t_max_fall_speed to {{ph_t_max_fall_speed}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.maxFallSpeed to {{ph_t_max_fall_speed}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/gravity.schema.json, set ph_t_mass to {{ph_t_mass}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.mass to {{ph_t_mass}}. Affects force-based movement and friction calculations.
